title: Jack Rabbit Cyber Rabbit Argon Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Argon by Jack Rabbit is an irresistible blend of two bold fruit flavours, lemon and blackcurrant. You might expect this juice to be overly sharp, but the flavours have been so expertly blended that the blackcurrant provides a wonderfully soft, deep and dark sweetness that’s perfectly balanced with the bright and zesty lemon. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
